question.en: What matters most for a happy life?
question.ja: 幸せな人生に一番効くのは？

hintEn: Sleep is more important than work.
If you don't sleep, you can't work well.
Work can wait. Sleep cannot.
Friends should be in the top two.
Money is nothing without friends.
We are happy because of people, not things.
Money must be number one.
Without money, we cannot buy food or rest.
Everything on this list needs money first.
Sleep should be last.
Sleeping is not happiness. It is just rest.
We can be happy with only five hours of sleep.
Food belongs in the middle, at number three.
Food is important, but not the top two.
Let's put food third, above work.
Work should be second, not first.
Work gives us meaning, so it is almost the top.
Put work right after the first one.

keyExpressions.en: I think X is more important than Y.
Can we put X in second place?
I don't agree. X should be lower.

hintEn: Humor is more important than knowledge.
A funny teacher keeps students awake.
Books have knowledge. Only people have humor.

goals.ja: knowledgeを下から2位以内にする
hintEn: Knowledge should be near the bottom.
We can look up facts on our phones.
Knowing a lot does not mean teaching well.
Patience has to be first.
Without patience, a teacher gets angry and we stop asking.
Every other point needs patience to work.
Humor should be last.
A funny class is not always a good class.
We come to learn, not to laugh.
Fairness should be second.
Fairness is almost the most important, but not quite.
Put fairness just under the first one.
Passion belongs in the middle, at three.
Passion matters, but two other things matter more.
Let's agree on passion for third place.

keyExpressions.en: For me, the most important thing is X.
keyExpressions.ja: 私にとって一番大事なのはXだ

keyExpressions.en: Why do you put X so high?
keyExpressions.ja: なぜXをそんなに上にするの？

keyExpressions.en: Let's move X down one place.

question.en: What matters most when you travel?
question.ja: 旅行で一番大事なのは？

hintEn: Food is more important than price.
I will pay more for good food.
A cheap trip with bad food is a bad trip.
Safety should be in the top three.
If a place is not safe, nothing else matters.
We can enjoy the trip only when we feel safe.
Price must be number one.
If it is too expensive, we cannot go at all.
Everything starts from the budget.
Weather should be last.
We cannot control the weather, so it is not a real point.
Rain or sun, a good trip is still good.
People should be fourth.
People are nice, but they are not the reason we travel.
Put people just above the last one.
Food should be second.
Food is almost the best part, but one thing is bigger.
Let's put food right after the top.

keyExpressions.en: First, second, third... let's decide the top one.
X and Y are close, but X is higher.
keyExpressions.ja: XとYは近いが、Xの方が上だ

keyExpressions.en: Is everyone OK with this order?

question.en: What matters most in a smartphone?
question.ja: スマホ選びで一番大事なのは？

hintEn: Battery is more important than camera.
A dead phone takes no photos.
I use the battery all day. I use the camera sometimes.

goals.ja: weightを下から2位以内にする
hintEn: Weight should be near the bottom.
All phones today are light enough.
Nobody buys a phone because it is light.
The camera has to be first.
We choose a phone to take pictures of our life.
The camera is the one part we show other people.
Price should be last.
A phone lasts three years, so a little more money is fine.
Cheap phones cost more in the end.
The screen should be third.
The screen matters, but two things matter more.
Let's put the screen in the middle.
Battery must be exactly number one.
Everything else is useless at zero percent.
Nothing beats a phone that lasts all day.

keyExpressions.en: I use X every day, so it should be higher.
keyExpressions.ja: Xは毎日使うから、もっと上のはず

keyExpressions.en: That makes sense, but what about Y?
keyExpressions.ja: それは分かるが、Yはどう？

hintEn: Coworkers are more important than salary.
We spend eight hours a day with these people.
Good money cannot fix a bad team.
Hours should be in the top two.
Time is the one thing we cannot buy back.
Short hours give us a life outside work.
Salary has to be first.
We work to live, and living costs money.
A nice team does not pay the rent.
The boss should be last.
Bosses change every two years anyway.
We can work well even with a quiet boss.
The commute should be third.
One hour on a train every day is real, but not the top.
Let's put the commute in the middle of the list.
Coworkers should be exactly last.
We do not choose our coworkers, so it is not a condition.
Work is work. Friends are outside.

keyExpressions.en: In my experience, X is the biggest problem.
keyExpressions.ja: 経験上、Xが一番の問題だ

keyExpressions.en: I can accept X in third place.
keyExpressions.ja: Xが3位なら受け入れられる

keyExpressions.en: Wait, that is too low for X.
keyExpressions.ja: 待って、Xがそれでは低すぎる

question.en: What helps you learn English most?
question.ja: 英語の上達に一番効くのは？

hintEn: Music helps more than reading.
We remember songs for years. We forget books.
Music teaches rhythm, and rhythm makes you sound natural.

goals.ja: gamesを下から2位以内にする
hintEn: Games should be near the bottom.
In games we only read short words like 'go' and 'attack'.
Games are fun, but we play in our own language.
Speaking must be number one.
You cannot learn to swim by watching videos.
Only speaking makes you use the words yourself.
Music should be last.
We sing the words without knowing the meaning.
Song English is strange English.
Movies should be exactly second.
Movies give us real speed and real faces, but we stay quiet.
Put movies right under the top one.
Reading should be fourth.
Reading builds words slowly, so it is near the bottom.
Let's put reading just above the last one.

keyExpressions.en: This one helped me the most.
I see your point, but I still think X is higher.
keyExpressions.ja: 言いたいことは分かるが、それでもXが上だと思う

keyExpressions.en: OK, let's decide. X is first.
